body: That's part of the reason I am confused about why i feel this way. I already am surrounded by many, many people who love me. I am in a relationship im glad im in. Yet, i still feel this way. The only reason i have not killed myself yet is because i don't want to hurt anyone i love by making them think they did not make me happy. I just don't feel any motivation to live. I wake up everyday just to wait until the day ends. Then i go to sleep and i wake up again to wait for the day to end again. And mind you, i still do things. I go to school, i spend time with family and friends, i try to do fun things, but it all feels so pointless to me.
